source.title: WeLion SHP270-16 Semi-Solid-State datasheet
source.note: Facts only; source body is not redistributed. WeLion NMC+ semi-solid pouch cell. Hosted by Universal Transmissions GmbH, the official European distributor (https://welion-energy.com/Imprint/). The sheet describes reference specifications, not a performance guarantee. Semi-solid describes the electrolyte; it is not all-solid-state. Ultrafast/standard C-rate rows are not identified as capacity-test conditions or continuous maximum current ratings and are not converted to amperes. Unqualified maximal/minimal voltages are held rather than assigned an absolute safety or charge-cutoff meaning. Identity mapping: https://welion-energy.com/SHP270-16/30000109; SHA-256 8db09795fc22ecebec24ea6623c62eb4574d097d0ed827b7ddc48289070c5cb4; manufacturer part PL7874172-16Ah.
